throughline.zh: 京鼎與多家台灣設備商揭露廠房資產及營收，奇鋐公布散熱業務合併收入，印尼巴淡島供水與台積電 3D DRAM 傳聞也分別出現新的可核對資訊。
throughline.en: Foxsemicon and Taiwanese equipment companies disclosed property and revenue developments, AVC reported thermal-management sales, and new reporting documented Batam water concerns and TSMC's response to a 3D DRAM rumor.

title.zh: 先進封裝、精密設備與海外廠房資產
title.en: Advanced packaging, precision equipment and overseas factory assets

summary.zh: 京鼎於 11 月 6 日核准購入泰國羅勇府土地廠房，尚未公布設備進場；11 月 8 日均華、均豪、志聖與東捷分別揭露 10 月營收與去年同期基期。不同公司的合併營收涵蓋各自的產品與驗收口徑，不宜視為同一批封裝設備的實際出貨量。
summary.en: Foxsemicon approved a Rayong factory-property purchase on November 6 without commissioning details. On November 8 Gallant, Gallant Micro, C Sun and Contrel reported October results with explicit year-earlier bases; their consolidated revenue figures cover different tools, customers and acceptance periods.

title.zh: 工業供電、機櫃散熱及量產收入
title.en: Industrial power, rack cooling and realized sales

summary.zh: 高雄市府於 11 月 7 日補充中鋼 3.575MW 燃料電池工程規劃，尚未投產；奇鋐 11 月 8 日公布 10 月營收約 221 億元、年增 34.35%。前者為未來裝置容量，後者為已實現合併營收，兩者衡量的產業活動不同。
summary.en: Kaohsiung detailed a planned 3.575MW China Steel fuel-cell project on November 7, while AVC disclosed NT$22.103 billion October sales on November 8, up 34.35% YoY. The project figure is a future capacity plan, whereas the sales figure reflects recorded consolidated revenue.

title.zh: 東南亞資料中心工程、供水與電力政策
title.en: Southeast Asian data-center construction, water and power policy

summary.zh: Sunway Construction 11 月 5 日公告馬來西亞 Serendah 工程合約，與 4 月同址案範圍尚待釐清；11 月 8 日法新社訪查印尼巴淡島居民停水爭議，當地供水單位指出乾旱與供電故障。美國議員另外提出未來資料中心電價立法方向，目前均未有新法生效或機房取水的獨立因果資料。
summary.en: SunCon's November 5 Serendah contract has unresolved overlap with an earlier filing, while AFP reported Batam water-supply disputes on November 8 and the local utility cited drought and power faults. US legislative ideas concerning data-center electricity costs remain proposals, and no facility-level proof links individual water outages to data centers.

title.zh: 先進記憶體傳聞、台積電聲明與華邦電擴建計畫
title.en: Advanced-memory rumor, TSMC response and Winbond expansion plans

summary.zh: 11 月 6 日匿名來源稱台積電評估 3D DRAM，台積電發言人 11 月 7 日透過媒體重申專注邏輯晶圓代工，未確認記憶體廠投資。華邦電董事長 11 月 7 日談及先前核准的高雄模組 B 擴建預算，這筆舊有資本支出與台積電傳聞沒有已揭露的專案關係。
summary.en: Anonymous reports on November 6 alleged TSMC might assess 3D DRAM, while its spokesperson reaffirmed the logic-foundry mandate on November 7 without announcing a memory-fab investment. Winbond's commentary concerned an earlier approved Kaohsiung Module B budget and provides no documented link to that rumor.
